seo.h1: Direct Flights from Ho Chi Minh City (SGN)
seo.intro: Departing from Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN), passengers can fly direct to over 30 international destinations and every major domestic airport across Vietnam. Compare operating airlines, flight times, weekly frequencies, and latest fares.
seo.title: Direct Flights from Ho Chi Minh City (SGN): Direct Routes & Airlines | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Explore nonstop destinations across Southeast Asia, East Asia, Europe, and Australia
seo.meta_description: Find verified nonstop direct flights from Ho Chi Minh City (SGN). Compare airlines, flight times, weekly schedules, and fares across Asia, Europe, and Australia.

faqs.answer: Vietnam Airlines and Vietjet Air operate the largest direct network from SGN, complemented by regional and international flag carriers including Singapore Airlines, Thai Airways, Cathay Pacific, and Emirates.
faqs.question: Which airlines operate direct international flights from Ho Chi Minh City?

faqs.answer: The longest nonstop flight departing from Ho Chi Minh City connects to Western Europe, including direct flights to London Heathrow (LHR) and Paris (CDG), taking approximately 12 to 13 hours.
faqs.question: What is the longest direct flight from Ho Chi Minh City?

faqs.answer: The shortest international direct flight from Ho Chi Minh City is to Phnom Penh (PNH), Cambodia, with a scheduled flying time of roughly 50 minutes to 1 hour.
